family.description: This family consists of several insect proteins including protamine A (ProtA), protamine B (ProtB) and protamine-like protein 99C (Prtl99C) from Drosophila melanogaster. They contain a HMG-box and are involved in chromatin compaction during spermiogenesis [[cite:PUB00083892],[cite:PUB00083890]]. Prtl99C is a sperm chromatin-associated protein that is essential for male fertility [[cite:PUB00083890]].
family.name: Protamine and protamine like
